# Sayloud

> Text to speech, speech to text and a teleprompter for iPhone and iPad, by Visto Apps (https://vistoapps.com).

Sayloud reads PDFs, EPUBs, web articles, scanned pages and pasted text aloud with the current word highlighted, using built-in Apple voices on the device and optional cloud voices. It turns live speech and audio or video files into text on the device (Transcribe), and runs a teleprompter whose script follows your voice and can record video (Prompter). It needs iOS 18 or later, has no account, and is not yet on the App Store.

Free to download with ads and monthly limits on transcription and Prompter sessions. A paid level removes ads and unlocks cloud voices, unlimited transcription and Prompter sessions and longer files, as a weekly or monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
